# Cairns

Type: Point of interest | Internal ID: Waymarker01 | Waymarker02 | Location: Mountain | Resources: Stone

# Introduction

Cairns are Points of interest found in the Mountain. They look like piles of rocks.
They do not have any particular purpose. They can be destroyed for 3 to 6 Stones.

Categorias: Points of interest
